ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t37

ddl_steps.name: base table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t37.users (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL, age int)

ddl_steps.name: add column

ddl_steps.name: add constraint pk-style
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users ADD CONSTRAINT users_age_check CHECK (age >= 0)

ddl_steps.name: drop constraint
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users DROP CONSTRAINT users_age_check

ddl_steps.name: rename column
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users RENAME COLUMN tags TO labels

ddl_steps.name: set storage parameters
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users SET (fillfactor = 80)

ddl_steps.name: set tablespace
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users SET TABLESPACE pg_default

ddl_steps.name: set logged/unlogged

ddl_steps.name: replica identity

ddl_steps.name: cluster on index

ddl_steps.name: disable/enable trigger

ddl_steps.name: disable/enable rule

ddl_steps.name: partition attach/detach
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t37.events (id bigint) PARTITION BY RANGE (id); CREATE TABLE t37.events_p1 (id bigint); ALTER TABLE t37.events ATTACH PARTITION t37.events_p1 FOR VALUES FROM (0) TO (100); ALTER TABLE t37.events DETACH PARTITION t37.events_p1

ddl_steps.name: inherit/no inherit
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t37.parent_t (id int); CREATE TABLE t37.child_t () INHERITS (t37.parent_t); ALTER TABLE t37.child_t NO INHERIT t37.parent_t

ddl_steps.name: set/drop not null
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users ALTER COLUMN email DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN email SET NOT NULL

ddl_steps.name: owner to
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE ROLE t37_owner LOGIN; ALTER TABLE t37.users OWNER TO t37_owner

ddl_steps.name: rename table
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users RENAME TO users_v2

ddl_steps.name: set schema
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE t37.users_v2 SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: drop column
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE public.users_v2 DROP COLUMN labels

ddl_steps.name: if exists guard
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS t37.missing DROP COLUMN x

ddl_steps.name: cleanup
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t37 CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.users_v2; DROP ROLE t37_owner

setup.sql: CREATE TABLE pgns_rename_relation.t(id int,payload text); INSERT INTO pgns_rename_relation.t VALUES(1,'keep'); CREATE SEQUENCE pgns_rename_relation.guard START 7; CREATE SEQUENCE pgns_rename_relation.taken; CREATE TABLE pgns_rename_relation.receipt AS SELECT c.oid,c.relnamespace,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relfilenode FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND c.relname NOT IN ('receipt','types_receipt'); CREATE TABLE pgns_rename_relation.types_receipt AS SELECT t.oid,t.typnamespace,t.typname,t.typelem,t.typarray FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND t.typname NOT IN ('receipt','_receipt','types_receipt','_types_receipt')

post_verify.assert: audit preserves exact relation and file identity
post_verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ((TABLE pgns_rename_relation.receipt EXCEPT (SELECT c.oid,c.relnamespace,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relfilenode FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND c.relname NOT IN ('receipt','types_receipt'))) UNION ALL ((SELECT c.oid,c.relnamespace,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relfilenode FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND c.relname NOT IN ('receipt','types_receipt')) EXCEPT TABLE pgns_rename_relation.receipt)) AS delta

post_verify.assert: audit preserves exact type names and array links
post_verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ((TABLE pgns_rename_relation.types_receipt EXCEPT (SELECT t.oid,t.typnamespace,t.typname,t.typelem,t.typarray FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND t.typname NOT IN ('receipt','_receipt','types_receipt','_types_receipt'))) UNION ALL ((SELECT t.oid,t.typnamespace,t.typname,t.typelem,t.typarray FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pgns_rename_relation','pgns_rename_relation_dst') AND t.typname NOT IN ('receipt','_receipt','types_receipt','_types_receipt')) EXCEPT TABLE pgns_rename_relation.types_receipt)) AS delta
